def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Compact polynomial model for log10(|ID|/A)."""
    
    # Add your improved polynomial coefficients here
    a = parameters[0]
    b = parameters[1]
    c = parameters[2]
    d = parameters[3]
    
    return a + b * (gate_voltage_abs - c) + d * (drain_voltage_abs - c)
